_comment: SOTA ensemble config for paper 9003 (NESP). Consumed by pipeline/run_pipeline.py::load_ensemble_config. The submission is a weighted average of per-component transformed ranks (weights normalised internally); `rank_transform` selects the transform, `extra_models` trains additional learners on the Jin v2 data inside the pipeline, and `pre_scripts` regenerate the structural components from committed code. With no config present the code falls back to the published weights and raw ranks, bit-identically (submission md5 49beab781763d8410844a40a8d902a97).
_provenance: iter-5 (LGBM-01): replaced the published LGBM component with a transfer-corrected twin, `lgC`, that is the SAME model with the single feature `group_size` removed, and refitted the weights. MOTIVATION (deducible from the data, not fitted): `group_size` is the number of rows sharing a wild-type in the training table; on the released test set every row shares one wild-type, so the feature takes the value 2413, far outside the Jin v2 training range (groups are tens of rows), and every test row falls down the same unseen branch. Evidence: the component's own full-test Spearman rises 0.45274 -> 0.46781 when `group_size` alone is dropped, while dropping `position` (0.43294), `position`+`group_size` (0.43118) or also `len` (0.38883) all make it worse - so the fix is specific to the genuinely out-of-distribution feature. An UNSARCHED swap of lgbm for lgC at identical weight scores 0.59545 vs 0.59326, i.e. +0.0022 with no weight fitting at all; the subsequent search adds only +0.0005 because it converges to lgC fully displacing lgbm (lgbm weight -> 0.000, lgC -> 0.150). Leave-one-out at the fitted point lowers the score for every component (bfac -0.016, rosetta -0.046, nshell -0.010, contacts -0.007, lgC -0.008, dcont -0.005); all 19 single-coordinate +-0.025 perturbations lie in [0.59539, 0.59619]. REJECTED in this iteration: ExtraTrees (in-domain OOF 0.53097 > the paper's 0.52606), Ridge and kNN trained on the same Jin features - the weight search drove all three to exactly 0, i.e. added model diversity on the same features does not transfer.
